_comment: REFERENTIAL market price data. Every figure below is quoted from a named, dated, published third-party source and is NOT derived from Octoru's own listings. The builder renders these as a clearly-labeled REFERENTIAL range ('each clinic sets its own rate'), never as a quote and never as a clinic's own price. Nothing here may be invented, blended across sources, or extrapolated from national to local. A treatment with no credible published figure carries reference:null and renders an honest empty state.
_rules: national.* = a figure published for the United States as a whole.
metro.* = a figure published specifically for the Miami metro area. Absent where the source did not publish one. NEVER synthesize a metro figure from a national one.
Surgical ASPS figures are SURGEON FEE ONLY and exclude anesthesia and facility fees — excludes_anesthesia_facility must stay true so the page says so.
RealSelf figures are patient self-reported and must be labeled as such on the page.
